description: This file defines the 'FileDescriptor' class, a wrapper around a file descriptor to ensure safe passing and management of file descriptors within the 'firebolt::rialto::ipc' namespace. It includes constructors, assignment operators, and methods for validity checking, resetting, releasing, and clearing the descriptor.

classes.name: FileDescriptor
classes.description: A class that manages a file descriptor, ensuring safe duplication and management of the descriptor to prevent invalid usage.

methods.name: explicit FileDescriptor(int fd)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given file descriptor, duplicating it to ensure safety.

methods.name: FileDescriptor(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy constructor that duplicates the file descriptor from another instance.

methods.name: FileDescriptor &operator=(const FileDescriptor &other)
methods.description: Copy assignment operator that duplicates the file descriptor.

methods.name: ~FileDescriptor()
methods.description: Destructor that closes the file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: bool isValid() const
methods.description: Checks if the file descriptor is valid.

methods.name: void reset(int fd = -1)
methods.description: Resets the descriptor to a new value, duplicating if necessary.

methods.name: void clear()
methods.description: Clears the descriptor, setting it to an invalid state.

methods.name: int release()
methods.description: Releases ownership of the file descriptor, returning it and invalidating the internal descriptor.
